papers.title: Active Learning from Weak and Strong Labelers
papers.abstract: An active learner is given a hypothesis class, a large set of unlabeled examples and the ability to interactively query labels to an oracle of a subset of these examples; the goal of the learner is to learn a hypothesis in the class that fits the data well by making as few label queries as possible.   This work addresses active learning with labels obtained from strong and weak labelers, where in addition to the standard active learning setting, we have an extra weak labeler which may occasionally provide incorrect labels. An example is learning to classify medical images where either expensive labels may be obtained from a physician (oracle or strong labeler), or cheaper but occasionally incorrect labels may be obtained from a medical resident (weak labeler). Our goal is to learn a classifier with low error on data labeled by the oracle, while using the weak labeler to reduce the number of label queries made to this labeler. We provide an active learning algorithm for this setting, establish its statistical consistency, and analyze its label complexity to characterize when it can provide label savings over using the strong labeler alone.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文关于主动学习中的弱标签与强标签策略，与有限元代理模型或生物力学设计无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper addresses active learning with weak and strong labelers for classification, with no connection to FEA surrogate modeling, expensive simulation sampling, constraint handling, uncertainty quantification, or biomechanics design.

summary_zh.motivation: 在分类问题中利用弱标签器减少对强标签器的查询次数。
summary_zh.method: 提出一种结合强、弱标签器的主动学习算法，并分析其标签复杂度。
summary_zh.result: 证明算法在统计上一致，且能在一定条件下节省强标签器的使用。
summary_zh.validation: 理论分析与标签复杂度分析，无实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the number of expensive strong labeler queries in active learning by incorporating a cheaper but possibly inaccurate weak labeler.
summary_en.method: Proposes an active learning algorithm that alternately queries strong and weak labelers and provides a theoretical analysis of label complexity.
summary_en.result: The algorithm is shown to be statistically consistent and can reduce strong labeler queries under certain conditions.
summary_en.validation: Theoretical analysis of label complexity only, with no experimental validation.

papers.title: p-Markov Gaussian Processes for Scalable and Expressive Online Bayesian Nonparametric Time Series Forecasting
papers.abstract: In this paper we introduce a novel online time series forecasting model we refer to as the pM-GP filter. We show that our model is equivalent to Gaussian process regression, with the advantage that both online forecasting and online learning of the hyper-parameters have a constant (rather than cubic) time complexity and a constant (rather than squared) memory requirement in the number of observations, without resorting to approximations. Moreover, the proposed model is expressive in that the family of covariance functions of the implied latent process, namely the spectral Matern kernels, have recently been proven to be capable of approximating arbitrarily well any translation-invariant covariance function. The benefit of our approach compared to competing models is demonstrated using experiments on several real-life datasets.

summary_zh.motivation: 高效且表达力强的在线时间序列预测模型
summary_zh.method: 提出p-Markov高斯过程滤波器，实现常数时间复杂度和内存需求
summary_zh.result: 在多个真实数据集上优于竞争模型
summary_zh.validation: 通过真实数据集上的实验验证性能

summary_en.motivation: To develop a scalable and expressive online time series forecasting model with constant time and memory complexity.
summary_en.method: We propose the p-Markov GP filter, which is equivalent to GP regression but achieves constant complexity by exploiting Markov properties and spectral Matern kernels.
summary_en.result: The proposed model outperforms competing methods on several real-life time series datasets.
summary_en.validation: The method is validated on multiple real-world benchmark datasets, demonstrating improved predictive accuracy and efficiency.
